title: A broker request flag was not proof of an actual depot job
claim: Setting the depot's trader_requested flag to true left the broker without a TradeAtDepot job in this session, even though the depot screen reported that the broker could reach it. Toggling the normal depot controls created the missing job.
reproduction: Compare the request state, actual depot jobs, broker job and position, and the staffed trade screen. If a request has no job, inspect normal depot controls rather than assuming the flag alone completed the action.
evidence: Firsthand AI-assisted Namemerchants observations on 2026-11-02; sanitized summaries of native state, not a published save or raw telemetry.
The observed depot showed Broker requested, No job and Broker can access depot.
Choosing No trader needed and then Broker requested through the normal controls created TradeAtDepot; the broker subsequently reached the depot.
limitations: One live fortress on Windows; relevant mods were not fully inventoried. Community reproduction is pending. One observed state transition does not prove all direct flag writes fail. Exact pixel coordinates are layout-specific and are deliberately excluded.
